answers.ask: Should the park read as bright and cartoony, or a naturalistic modern city park?
answers.answer: Make it a bright, cartoony chill park that fits a Roblox clicker game.

answers.ask: Is the rebirth button a physical thing you walk up to in the park, or a screen button?
answers.answer: Make the rebirth button a physical button players walk up to in the park, with no text labels.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D game map as a bright, cartoony chill park that a Roblox character can freely walk around. Arrange open grassy paths and simple park scenery around a central physical rebirth button that players can walk up to; the button has no text label. Include a pet egg as a visible park prop or interaction point, also without ground text, signs, or on-screen labels.
agent_notes: Simulation: a clicker with rebirth doubling and an egg of rarity-tiered pets is an incremental progression game, and the pets are multipliers bought from an egg rather than an avatar-sim pet, so no second genre is named. world-open, the genre default, fits the answer's bright cartoony park as one shared walkable place with no personal plots. Incremental Simulator keeps its shape and its social-hub, which Simulation words as the eggs-and-upgrades bazaar and is a direct hit for the pet egg the whole park circulates around; path-circulation is the park paths, and trigger-rebirth was added because the answer makes the rebirth button a physical pad players walk up to rather than a screen button, while gate-progression was dropped since nothing is walled off. Decided without a user: the admin panel and global chat are UI with no layout consequence, and 'no labels or texts on my screen or on the ground' is carried as a constraint that the egg and the rebirth pad are read by their geometry, with no text signage generated.
